contract.event_metadata_isolation: A callback changing event metadata does not affect subsequent callbacks
contract.source_metadata_isolation: A callback changing source metadata does not affect subsequent callbacks
contract.payload_isolation: A callback changing nested payload data does not affect subsequent callbacks
contract.callback_independence: Each callback receives an independent event object
contract.source_payload_integrity: Callback mutations do not modify the original emitter payload
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after callback-local metadata mutations
contract.registry_stability: Callback metadata mutations do not modify the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus event delivery continues to require the events permission
